g.text: A surface concentration step diffuses progressively into a semi-infinite solid
One-dimensional semi-infinite diffusion with constant D, no reaction, initial uniform concentration and suddenly fixed surface value. Plot truncation at2
mm is a display window, not a second boundary. Penetration scale grows as√(Dt); profiles satisfy the diffusion PDE and boundary limits.
